description.value: Destination Inn is a fully renovated 22-room motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, situated at the south entrance of Kootenay National Park and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, and shops in the village core. The property features a common room lounge with a full kitchen, a cedar gazebo, BBQ area, and fire pit, with continental breakfast included for all guests. Its central location in one of BC's most popular mountain-resort villages makes it a practical and comfortable base for cyclists touring the Columbia Valley.
